suppress.notes: Quarkus 3.36.1 (all io.quarkus* modules). Revisit on quarkus.platform.version bump.
Netty 4.1.133.Final (all modules, transitive from Quarkus 3.36.1 BOM).

PostgreSQL JDBC 42.7.11 (transitive from Quarkus 3.36.1 BOM). CVE-2026-54291 Medium (CVSS ~5.9); only if channelBinding=require (not set here). Fixed in 42.7.12+; Quarkus 3.38 BOM ships 42.7.13 — revisit on platform bump.

Vert.x 4.5.27 (transitive from Quarkus 3.36.1 BOM). CVE-2026-15075 / CVE-2026-15076 High (CVSS ~8.2); HttpClient redirect header leak and WebClientSession Set-Cookie Domain validation. Fixed only after 4.5.29 — revisit on Quarkus platform bump that ships a patched Vert.x.
Apache Tika 3.3.0 (document-service and parser modules). CVE-2026-66755 Medium (CVSS ~5.9); ISA-Tab path traversal. Fixed in 3.3.2+ — revisit on tika.version bump.
junrar 7.5.8 (transitive from Apache Tika 3.3.0 in document-service).
Apache PDFBox 3.0.7 / jbig2-imageio 3.0.4 (transitive from Apache Tika 3.3.0).

Hibernate ORM 7.3.6.Final (Quarkus 3.36.1 BOM). CVE-2026-77874 High (CVSS ~7.1); JSON-path SQLi on Oracle / DB2 / HANA dialects. We use PostgreSQL dialects only. Revisit on quarkus.platform.version bump that ships a patched Hibernate.

jsoup 1.23.2 (override of Tika transitive). CVE-2026-75140 High (CVSS ~8.7); XmlTreeBuilder DoS. Affects through 1.23.2; fix is commit-only — no patched Maven release yet. Revisit when jsoup > 1.23.2 publishes.

snappy-java 1.1.10.8 (Quarkus / Kafka transitive). CVE-2026-90559 High (CVSS ~8.7); Snappy.uncompress ByteBuffer OOB write. No fixed Maven release beyond 1.1.10.8 yet. Revisit when xerial publishes a patch.
